It performs FOUR actions one after another, in exactly this timing:
0.0–1.0 s: idle — sits still and takes one calm breath.
1.0–2.0 s: nods its head down and back up twice, in a steady rhythm, the body and hands stay still.

3.0–4.0 s: lowers both arms back onto its knees and settles exactly into the starting pose.
It stays SITTING the whole time: it never stands up and never leaves the block. Each action is clearly separated and finished before the next one starts.

Background: flat solid bright green #00FF00, evenly lit, no shadows, no floor, no props, no text.

STYLE - "Watercolour and wycinanka": the BACKGROUND is a soft, airy WATERCOLOUR wash with wet-in-wet sky blooms and paper texture, pale and luminous (dove grey, ice blue, a blush of pink dusk), so the tab reads easily over it. The CUT-OUTS are in the manner of Polish folk paper-cutting (wycinanka): solid saturated paper in red, white, emerald, cobalt and black, with small symmetric cut-out ornaments (tulips, stars, zigzags) in the buildings and clothes, and a white paper rim. The EAGLE alone is painted in delicate watercolour like the background: white with soft blue-grey shadows, golden beak, talons and a golden band across each wing.
Crisp, readable, no watermark, no extra text.

The EAGLE alone is painted in the same oil style as the background: soft white feathers, golden beak and talons, a golden band across each wing.

content.text: [Static shot] A young white cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons and a golden band on each wing flies to the right in side view. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame, flying on the spot; its body does not travel. It flaps its wings in steady, strong, even wingbeats, one after another, all the same: each time both wings sweep powerfully down below its body, then rise back up and open wide above its back. Its body bobs gently with each beat. Its head stays level and looks ahead to the right, beak closed, eye bright. Legs stay tucked under its body. It ends exactly in its starting pose. Sound: soft wind only.

[Static shot] A young white cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons and a golden band on each wing flies to the right in side view. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame, flying on the spot; its body does not travel. First it gives two big, powerful wingbeats, sweeping both wings deep down below its body and back up high. Then it glides: it holds its wings out wide and still, spread flat to both sides, feathers fanned, soaring calmly for a moment. Last it lifts its wings back up into its starting pose. Its head stays level and looks ahead to the right, beak closed, eye bright. Legs stay tucked. It ends exactly in its starting pose. Sound: soft wind only.

[Static shot] A young white cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons and a golden band on each wing flies to the right in side view, wings raised. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame; its body does not travel. It makes two movements, gliding with its wings held between them. First it tips its head down and peers curiously at the ground far below, then lifts its head back. Then it turns its head toward the viewer, looks straight out at us with a bright cheeky smile, beak closed, and turns its head back to look ahead to the right. Its wings make slow small beats. It ends exactly in its starting pose. Sound: soft wind only.

[Static shot] A young white cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons and a golden band on each wing flies to the right in side view, wings raised. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame; its body does not travel. It makes two movements, flying calmly between them. content.text: [Static shot] A young white cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons and a golden band on each wing flies to the right in side view. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame, flying on the spot; its body does not travel. It flaps lightly and quickly in small, soft, easy wingbeats, one after another: its wings dip only a little below its back and lift again, never sweeping far down, as if it is cruising effortlessly on a gentle breeze. Its body stays almost level. Its head stays level and looks ahead to the right, beak closed, eye bright. Legs stay tucked. It ends exactly in its starting pose. Sound: soft wind only.

[Static shot] A young white cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons and a golden band on each wing flies to the right in side view, wings raised. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame; its body does not travel. It makes two playful movements, flying calmly between them. First it does a happy wobble: it banks and tilts its whole body and wings to one side, then to the other side, like a little roll in the air, and levels out again. Then it does a proud swoop: it dips its head and body down a little and swings back up with a strong wingbeat. Beak closed, eye bright and cheerful. It ends exactly in its starting pose. Sound: soft wind only.

content.text: [Static shot] an all-white heraldic cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons, a golden band ending in a trefoil on each wing, a scaled white breast and a white fleur-de-lis tail with a golden ring, flies to the right in side view, wings raised. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame, flying on the spot; its body does not travel. It flaps its wings in steady, strong, even wingbeats, one after another, all the same: each time both wings sweep powerfully down below its body, then rise back up and open wide above its back. Its body bobs gently with each beat. Its head stays level and looks ahead to the right, eye bright. Its talons stay tucked under its body, its tail stays straight. It stays all white and gold. It ends exactly in its starting pose. Sound: soft wind only.

[Static shot] an all-white heraldic cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons, a golden band ending in a trefoil on each wing, a scaled white breast and a white fleur-de-lis tail with a golden ring, flies to the right in side view, wings raised. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame, flying on the spot; its body does not travel. It flaps lightly and quickly in small, soft, easy wingbeats, one after another, all the same: its wings dip only a little and lift again, never sweeping far down, as if it is cruising effortlessly on a gentle breeze. Its body stays almost level. Its head stays level and looks ahead to the right, eye bright. Its talons stay tucked, its tail stays straight. It stays all white and gold. It ends exactly in its starting pose. Sound: soft wind only.

[Static shot] an all-white heraldic cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons, a golden band ending in a trefoil on each wing, a scaled white breast and a white fleur-de-lis tail with a golden ring, flies to the right in side view, wings raised. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame; its body does not travel. It makes two movements, flying calmly between them. First it tips its head down and peers curiously at the land far below, then lifts its head back. Then it turns its head toward the viewer, looks straight out at us with a bright cheerful eye, and turns its head back to look ahead to the right. Its wings make slow small beats. It stays all white and gold. It ends exactly in its starting pose. Sound: soft wind only.

[Static shot] an all-white heraldic cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons, a golden band ending in a trefoil on each wing, a scaled white breast and a white fleur-de-lis tail with a golden ring, flies to the right in side view, wings raised. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. The eagle stays in the same place in the frame; its body does not travel. It makes two movements. First it gives a quick happy shake of its whole body, ruffling its white feathers so they puff out, then they settle smooth again. Then it glides: it spreads its wings out wide and still to both sides, feathers fanned, soaring calmly for a moment, and lifts them back up. Its head looks ahead to the right. It stays all white and gold. It ends exactly in its starting pose. Sound: soft wind only.

[Static shot] an all-white heraldic cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons, a golden band ending in a trefoil on each wing, a scaled white breast and a white fleur-de-lis tail with a golden ring. The camera stays locked off; the framing and the lighting never change. At first the eagle stands upright with its wings folded, looking to the right. It crouches a little, then unfolds both wings wide, gives two big powerful wingbeats and springs up into the air, lifting its legs and tucking its talons under its body, and tilts forward until it flies level to the right in side view, wings raised, exactly as in the final picture. It stays roughly in the same place in the frame. Its eye is bright and eager. It stays all white and gold. Sound: soft wind and wingbeats only.

[Static shot] an all-white heraldic cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons, a golden band ending in a trefoil on each wing, a scaled white breast and a white fleur-de-lis tail with a golden ring. It stays in the same place in the frame. It stays all white and gold. Sound: soft wind only.

[Static shot] an all-white heraldic cartoon eagle with a golden beak, golden talons, a golden band ending in a trefoil on each wing, a scaled white breast and a white fleur-de-lis tail with a golden ring, stands upright with its wings folded, looking to the right. The crew: Kapitan Szabla (a SMALL clean-shaven boy captain, black tricorne with white plume, red cape, navy coat), Pieprznik (noodle-thin, striped shirt, BLUE knitted cap, long pepper mill), Grzmot (huge gentle bald giant with a TINY head, braces), Mała Lina (small girl, red knotted head-scarf, striped top, green trousers, a rope), Kapibara Skarb (a brown capybara, ALWAYS asleep). The ship is their small two-masted brig with patched cream sails and a cream pennant.

Panels, in reading order (row 1 left to right, then row 2):
1. Setting sail: the brig leaves a sunny little harbour, the crew waving, the capybara asleep on the chest.
2. The brig on the open sea, a cheeky puffing wind cloud blowing into the full sails, Szabla at the bow pointing ahead with his cutlass.
3. Story time on deck: Szabla plays the ukulele and tells a tale, Grzmot listens with his hand cupped to his ear, Lina sits on a barrel listening, Pieprznik covers his ears pretending not to listen.
4. The whole crew singing together with open mouths, arms on each other's shoulders, Szabla strumming the ukulele, musical notes in the air (drawn as simple shapes, no letters).
5. Pieprznik in the galley grinding pepper from his long mill over a jar of jam and a bowl of milk soup, about to sneeze, Lina holding her nose and laughing.
6. A friendly practice duel on deck: Szabla with his cutlass against Pieprznik with his pepper mill, both laughing, Lina cheering from the rope.
7. Szabla shouting very loudly through a speaking trumpet, the big sail tearing open in the wind, while the capybara sleeps on peacefully on the chest.
8. Arrival: the brig at the treasure island beach, the chest open full of black peppercorns, everyone cheering, the capybara still asleep.
